name: ActivityNarrated
description: Wearable human activity recognition (HAR) has made steady progress, yet much of this progress remains grounded in fixed-window, closed-set classification benchmarks. This formulation is poorly matched to everyday behavior, where activities are open-ended, unscripted, personalized, variable in duration, and often compositional. To address this mismatch, we introduce ActivityNarrated, an open-ended narrative paradigm for language-grounded wearable activity understanding.
